entries.03b5a280c60eb1ba: This business aims to build next-generation financial infrastructure by leveraging digital asset technologies such as stablecoins and tokenized deposits. Jointly with Progmat, it is advancing the cross-border stablecoin remittance infrastructure project “Project Pax” and conducting demonstration tests with financial institutions in Japan and overseas. This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Datachain (99.0% of voting rights owned). In the fiscal year ended September 2025, no revenue from external customers was recorded, and the business is at the stage of upfront investment in product development.

entries.0d618ecaef45b513: This business examines and demonstrates the social implementation of tokenized deposits using blockchain technology. It is working on demonstrations of record management models for funds and claims, demonstrations of payment and accounting linkage using smart contracts, and demonstrations of AI use aimed at automating the business processes of corporate clients and financial institutions. It started in November 2025, after the end of the fiscal year. Revenue from external customers is not disclosed by service, so no amount is stated.
entries.13ab462fa3df9b7f: A business providing consulting based on data analysis and outsourced advertising operations, among other services. It provides "Web Analytics", which supports improvements to websites; "Bantonaa", which integrates and visualizes data inside and outside a company; a trading desk that handles performance-based advertising operations end to end; the native ad distribution platform "UZOU"; and the DX consulting service "SPEC". A business handled by consolidated subsidiary ThinQ Healthcare Co., Ltd. Its base is at the head office in Minato-ku, Tokyo. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥5,105 million.
entries.2a1865cd522de028: A service that, through operating the nursing care facility search site "Keasuru Kaigo", refers individuals considering moving into nursing care facilities to multiple nursing care facility operators. It receives fees from nursing care facility operators for each deal closed with a referred user. It has a customer support structure that asks about requested conditions by phone. Revenue from external customers is not disclosed by service, so no amount is stated.

entries.a1b9162814ad9dfc: A service that, through operating the exterior wall painting bulk quotation site "Nurikae", refers individuals considering exterior wall painting work to multiple exterior wall painting contractors. It receives fees from contractors for each user referral and for each deal closed with a referred user. Its features include a customer support structure in which staff ask in detail about requested conditions by phone; it also runs matching in renovation areas other than exterior wall painting.
entries.af5ff2d4efcc3fec: This business aims to realize cross-border remittance that uses stablecoins, is fast and low-cost, and can operate 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. As a joint project with Progmat, “Project Pax,” it is building the remittance infrastructure; it has completed technical verification with Swift, an international financial network, and has started technical and operational verification with Shoko Chukin Bank, several regional banks and banks in South Korea. Revenue from external customers is not disclosed by service, so no amount is stated.
entries.cf085924a37e98c9: A business operating matching platforms that connect consumers and businesses in long-established industry sectors. Its main services are "Ieuru" for selling used real estate, "Nurikae" for exterior wall renovation and "Keasuru Kaigo" for finding nursing care facilities; after entering a market, it also supports businesses in improving operational efficiency, such as by providing tools. A business handled by consolidated subsidiary Velocity Co., Ltd. Its base is at the head office in Minato-ku, Tokyo. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥11,329 million.
